historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: mid-cycle organic revenue growth (SiC/EV content, AI data-center power, industrial recovery); every trailing CAGR is a cycle endpoint and none is used directly
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3y CAGR +7.4% diverges from revenue -10.4% and EPS -59.6%: FY2022 was the cycle peak and FY2025 the trough, so the 3-year window measures the downcycle, not trend; the 5-year window (FY2020 trough to FY2025 trough) is the cleaner read at +2.7% revenue / +23% owner FCF.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC incl. equity-award taxes - interest income), $M: FY2020 408.1, FY2021 1,195.8, FY2022 1,402.7, FY2023 157.4 (EFK fab purchase and SiC capex), FY2024 913.9, FY2025 1,150.1. Owner-FCF 3y CAGR -6.4% vs reported -3.9%: SBC+withholding has held at ~$175-190M while FCF fell, so SBC's share of the cash flow rose through the downcycle. GAAP EBITDA margin history: FY2018 23.1%, FY2019 18.6%, FY2020 18.5%, FY2021 28.0%, FY2022 35.0%, FY2023 38.1%, FY2024 34.0%, FY2025 12.8% (ex ~$650M restructuring/impairment ~24%); H1-2026 ex restructuring and accelerated depreciation ~29.5%.

scenario_narratives.base: The automotive/industrial inventory correction bottomed in late 2025; FY2026 lands at ~$6.6B on H1 actuals plus Q3 guidance, with non-GAAP gross margin recovering from 33% to the low 40s on utilisation and Fab Right (two fab divestitures, ~$35M savings from 2027). Organic growth of 8.5% in FY2027 fading to 3% by FY2035 blends EV/SiC content gains, AI data-center power (guided to more than double in 2026, from a small base) and a normal industrial cycle, with SiC pricing pressure and a slow China EV recovery holding the mature adjusted EBITDA margin at 33%, below the FY2022-24 peak. Synaptics closes mid-2027 and contributes ~$1.3B of revenue at a ~19% EBITDA margin and 12.5% SBC, plus the guided $200M synergies by FY2029; on an owner-FCF basis the deal is roughly neutral to slightly dilutive against the 12.2% of shares issued. Capex returns to the ~8% mid-cycle level by FY2029 and the owner-FCF margin settles around 15-16% of revenue.
scenario_narratives.bull: AI data-center power (48V then 800VDC with NVIDIA MGX and the hyperscalers) becomes a multi-billion-dollar franchise by 2029 while SiC pricing stabilises as Chinese substrate oversupply clears and EV penetration re-accelerates in Europe and the US; the 300mm East Fishkill ramp and the exited subscale fabs lift the mature adjusted EBITDA margin to 36%, approaching the FY2023 peak of 38%. Synaptics' Astra edge-AI compute and connectivity attach to onsemi's power/sensing sockets and the synergies exceed the $200M guide. Organic growth of 11% in FY2027 and 9% in FY2028-29 fades to 3.5%; capex runs at 8.5% to fund it and the terminal cap is 17x.
scenario_narratives.bear: The recovery proves to be restocking rather than demand: ex-China auto production and EV adoption disappoint again in 2027, China BEV makers shift SiC sourcing to domestic suppliers, and SiC ASP declines outrun cost-downs so PSG margins compress; ISG loses further share to Sony. Organic revenue falls 2% in FY2027 and is flat in FY2028, and the adjusted EBITDA margin re-compresses to 26.5% (the FY2025 ex-restructuring trough was ~24%) before recovering only to 28%. Synaptics still closes, so the 12% dilution and its 12.5% SBC load land while the $200M synergies only partly offset the integration cost. Capex is held at 7.5%, terminal growth at 2.5% and the cap at 12x. This scenario stays cash-generative; it does not test the zero floor.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Mid-cycle owner-FCF DCF on the pro forma combined company. Neither the FY2024 peak (34% GAAP EBITDA margin, $914M owner FCF) nor the FY2025 trough (13% GAAP / ~24% adjusted margin, FCF propped by inventory release and capex at half of D&A) is extrapolated: the forward flows are built from a 30% adjusted EBITDA margin in FY2026 rising to 33% mid-cycle, capex returning to 8% of revenue and a -15% working-capital drag on growth. SBC including equity-award taxes is fully expensed and the share count held flat; the flat count is funded by ON's $1.4B/yr buyback. The Synaptics merger is modelled as completing (all three scenarios), with the standalone value recorded as a memo so the price of the deal is explicit. One WACC, 10%; risk lives in the scenario flows and the 25/50/25 weights.
key_risks_to_valuation: Cycle: a second leg down in auto/industrial demand repeats the FY2025 margin collapse; the bear case prices this but the real history (FY2019-20 margins of 18-19%) is worse than the bear path
SiC price competition from Chinese substrate and device makers compressing PSG margins structurally, not cyclically
China EV exposure: domestic-supplier preference and policy shifts; US export-control and tariff risk
Synaptics: regulatory (HSR, foreign-investment regimes), $320M reverse termination fee, integration of a 12.5%-SBC software/edge-AI business into an IDM, synergies below the $200M guide
Leverage: gross debt rose to $4.5B in May-2026 ($1.5B of 0% 2031 converts); net debt is modest at ~$0.6B standalone but the $805M 2027 converts are current and in the money
Terminal-value share of the valuation is high for a cyclical; the 15x cap (12x bear) is what disciplines it
Revenue reference year: the FY2026 base rests on Q3 guidance and a seasonal Q4; a Q3 miss in early November would move year-1 directly

standalone_memo.description: ON ex-Synaptics on identical organic driver paths (no Synaptics revenue layers, SBC blend or synergies), shares 394.1M, net debt $640.4M; same WACC, caps and weights. Run through the same engine on 2026-10-02 immediately before this build.
standalone_memo.reading: The headline pro forma weighted value is compared against this figure in the final report; the difference per share is the model's price of the Synaptics deal at a $200M synergy run-rate.

inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 10-K cash-flow statement: SBC add-back $144.3M plus $29.1M taxes paid on net-share settlement of equity awards (financing activities); no combined figure is published, so the two lines are summed. H1-2026: $74.7M + $45.5M.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 repurchases $1,377.6M (financing cash flow); H1-2026 $690.5M including $331.9M bought concurrently with the May-2026 notes. New $6.0B authorisation (Nov-2025). The flat count is funded: ON is a heavy repurchaser.
inputs.share_count_basis: PRO FORMA for the pending all-stock Synaptics merger, held FLAT (SBC is fully expensed in the flows). ON standalone 394.1M = 389.3M basic at 3-Jul-2026 (Q2-26 10-Q cover) + ~4.0M RSU/ESPP dilution + ~0.8M for the in-the-money excess on the 0% 2027 converts (conversion price $74.34; principal settled in cash and carried in debt). The 404.4M diluted weighted count in the 10-Q counts those converts as 10.8M if-converted shares AND they sit in debt, so it is not used. Plus 54.7M new ON shares for Synaptics (~40.5M SYNA shares incl. accelerated RSUs x 1.350 exchange ratio; the 8-K says ~12% of the combined company, this gives 12.2%). The 0.50% 2029 converts ($156.78) and the 0% 2031 converts ($161.30, call spread to $211.54) are out of the money and treated as debt only.
inputs.net_debt_note: ON at 3-Jul-2026: gross principal $4,504.9M (0.50% converts 2029 $1,500M; 0% converts 2031 $1,500M issued May-2026, net proceeds $1,473.7M; 0% converts 2027 $804.9M, current; 3.875% notes 2028 $700M) less cash $3,514.5M and short-term investments $350M = $640.4M. The Metrics.csv TotalDebt of $5,307M for the latest quarter double-counts the $802.1M current portion (LongTermDebt + LongTermDebtCurrent XBRL tags) and is NOT used. Plus Synaptics at 27-Jun-2026: debt $837.3M less cash $442.5M = $394.8M. Pro forma net debt $1,035.2M.
inputs.wacc_rationale: USD flows. 10y UST ~4.2% + beta ~1.4 x 5.0% ERP = ~11.2% cost of equity; ~1.5% pre-tax (1.2% after-tax) cost of the mostly-convertible debt stack; ~12% debt weight at market -> ~10.0% WACC. One WACC across all three scenarios: cyclicality, China/SiC pricing and deal risk are charged in the scenario flows and weights, not in the rate (risk charged once).
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) operating lease cost stays inside EBITDA (US GAAP operating leases are an operating expense; $21M of lease payments in H1-26 OCF); the $226M operating lease liability is excluded from net debt. No principal deduction, so no double charge.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (scenario-weighted), routed via dcf-methods SKILL.md: operating semiconductor IDM, cyclical, so owner-fcf.md plus the cyclical adaptations. First valuation of this ticker. Owner FCF FY2025 = 1,418.6 reported - 173.4 SBC incl. equity-award taxes - 95.1 interest income = 1,150.1; interest income is stripped because the $3.9B gross cash sits in the net-debt bridge and the forward build is unlevered EBITDA. FY2025 owner FCF is itself NOT mid-cycle: it carries a $273M inventory release and trough-level capex ($341M vs $686M D&A) while EBITDA was at a cycle low, so the forward flows are built from components rather than grown from it. PRO FORMA SYNAPTICS: ON agreed on 2026-06-25 (amended 2026-10-01) to acquire Synaptics for 1.350 ON shares per SYNA share, ~$7B EV at announcement, closing guided mid-2027 subject to SYNA stockholder vote and regulatory approvals (HSR filed 17-Jul-2026). All three scenarios assume completion: Synaptics (June-FY2026 revenue $1,197M, OCF $149M, capex $48M, SBC $149M, i.e. ~zero owner FCF before synergies) enters the revenue path as a half year in FY2027 and a full year from FY2028, with the guided $200M annual synergies phased 50% FY2028 / 100% FY2029; shares and net debt are pro forma from day one. A STANDALONE run on identical organic paths (shares 394.1M, net debt $640.4M) is recorded in valuation_philosophy.standalone_memo so the per-share price of the deal is explicit. The H1-2026 cash flow (~$640M reported FCF) is already partly in the 3-Jul-2026 balance sheet while fy0 flows are FY2025; the offsetting H1-2026 buybacks ($690M) are in the lower share count, so the vintage mix is roughly neutral.

bear.growth_note: FY2027 organic -2% and FY2028 organic flat (auto/China roll-over) with the Synaptics layers on top; FY2029 trough +1%, then 2.5-3% nominal.

base.growth_note: FY2026 = H1 actual $3,116.8M + Q3 guide midpoint $1.70B + Q4 ~$1.76B = ~$6.58B (+9.7%). FY2027 = organic +8.5% plus a half year of Synaptics (~$650M); FY2028 = organic +6.5% plus the remaining Synaptics half year (~$720M). Organic thereafter decelerates 6.5% -> 3% as the recovery matures.
base.margin_note: Adjusted EBITDA (pre-SBC, ex restructuring/impairment). FY2026 ~30% = Q2-26 non-GAAP GM 39.3% / Q3 guide 40-42% less ~20% non-GAAP opex plus ~10% D&A. Organic path 32% FY2027 -> 33% mid-cycle (below the FY2022-24 peak of 34-38%, above the 2018-20 pre-Fab-Right 18-23%), blended with Synaptics at ~19% adj EBITDA margin and the $200M synergies phased in FY2028-29.
base.sbc_note: ON 2.9% of revenue incl. equity-award taxes; Synaptics runs ~12.5%, so the blend steps up to ~4.3% at full consolidation and then declines 0.1pp/yr.
base.capex_note: FY2026 ~$230M (H1 actual $56M) after the FY2023-24 capacity build; returns to the FY2018-21 mid-cycle ~8% of revenue by FY2029 and matches terminal D&A.
base.tax_note: Non-GAAP rate ~16%; cash taxes paid were 16.5% (FY2023) and 19% (FY2024) of pre-tax; FY2025 was a loss-shielded 1% and is not carried forward.
base.wc_note: Manufacturer: inventory (~33% of revenue) + receivables (~14%) exceed payables (~11%), so growth consumes cash; -15% of the revenue change.
base.terminal_note: Cap 15x owner FCF for a cyclical IDM (method: 12-15x for cyclicals).

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 25%: onsemi has just demonstrated how violently its margins compress (gross margin 45% to 33%, operating margin negative) in a single downcycle, roughly half of revenue is automotive with material China/SiC-pricing exposure, and it has layered a pending all-stock acquisition with its own regulatory and integration risk on top. Bull cut from 35% to 25% because it needs AI data-center power, SiC pricing stabilisation, European/US EV re-acceleration and Synaptics synergies to deliver together. Base stays at 50%.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
